entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  resistance proximity = 2.20% away -> -55 (weight 1.6) - Resistance 2,546.72 (2 touches)
  RSI 1h = 72.7 -> -40 (weight 2.0) - Overbought - entries here chase the move
  RSI divergence (1d) = bearish -> -23 (weight 1.3) - strength 67/100
  Bollinger position = 66% of band -> -25 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = +2.12% -> -13 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,491.95 vs EMA20 2,440.25
  MACD divergence (1h) = hidden bullish -> +12 (weight 1.3) - strength 33/100
  RSI daily = 57.5 -> -3 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (10.4) = -23.1 -> UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
